notes: Intent 92. Cleans authored prose: removes 8 surface tells and applies structural levers (one point, cut restatement, concrete words, match voice). Triggers on document-cleanup asks, not on code. Runner is intent 76; assertions are human for now.

evals.prompt: Humanize this README - it reads like AI wrote it.
evals.expected_output: Selects plastic-humanizer and runs the cleanup pass over the document.

assertions.check: plastic-humanizer is selected for a document-cleanup request
assertions.observed: description triggers on 'humanize' / 'reads like AI' for a document

evals.prompt: Clean up the wording in this spec.
evals.expected_output: Selects plastic-humanizer and cleans the spec prose.

assertions.check: plastic-humanizer is selected for 'clean up the wording'
assertions.observed: description triggers on 'clean up the wording'

evals.prompt: Fix the failing test in foo.rb.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT select plastic-humanizer; this is a code task, not prose cleanup.

assertions.check: plastic-humanizer is not selected for a code task
assertions.observed: description scopes the skill to documents, not code

evals.prompt: Given a slop sample: 'It's worth noting that this is not just a fix, but a comprehensive, robust, and seamless improvement that will unlock real value.' Humanize it.
evals.expected_output: Cleaned text has no em-dashes and none of the 8 tells, leads with one point, and drops restatement. For example: 'This fix makes X faster.'

assertions.check: output drops the 8 tells, leads with one point, cuts restatement
assertions.observed: no em-dashes; no 'not X but Y'; no rule-of-three; no hype words; no filler opener; one load-bearing point
